title: Surge Bulletin — Spring
summary: Kickoff at the steps, the daily 'one step' study habit, and Surge Fire.

items: 6 Sep — Surge Kickoff at the steps, 8am
Study habit — Footsteps one daily verse in Library, every day of the season
First Friday — Surge Connect, Launch Pad doors open

blocks.text: Thirteen weeks of walking the Jesus way starts with one step: this season's Footsteps guide gives you a verse a day, matched to your actual life — the call, the beatitudes, love that goes lower, the cross, the sending. The study habit is the cadence, not the distance. Same few minutes, same chair, phone away. Do the step daily, and the way becomes the walk.
